The '''Silversisi system''' was a part of the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It shared its name with the [[Library of Silversisi]].<ref name="BoS">''[[Book of Sith: Secrets from the Dark Side]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Silversisi [[Star system/Legends|system]] was introduced in the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square M-8.<ref name="EAOC" />
